artworks.title: A Town on a Hilltop (Sanctuary of Lampedusa)
artworks.medium: gray wash with touches of pen and black ink on card
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains in the background. The brushstrokes are loose and capture the details of the trees and the building on the mountainside. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from light gray to deep charcoal. A small figure is visible on a path.

artworks.title: Figures Setting Out in Canoes from a Palm Grove (Wady Feiran)
artworks.medium: gray and black wash on card
artworks.description: The image shows tall palm trees clustered on the right side of a landscape. Near the foreground, a small boat with two figures is on a body of water. The water reflects the trees and figures. In the background, there are pointed mountain peaks meeting the sky. The horizon is low, marked by the distant mountains. The brushstrokes depict textures of palm fronds and tree trunks. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black, highlighting the natural elements in the scene.

artworks.title: River Winding through a Rock Formation (Philae, Egypt)
artworks.medium: gray wash on card
artworks.description: The image shows rock formations surrounding a body of water, viewed at water level. There is a lack of clearly defined horizon. The rocks have vertical lines, creating a sense of grandeur. The brushstrokes vary in texture, depicting the surfaces of the rocks. The color scheme is mainly grayscale, using light and shadow for depth. Watercolors are used for a subtle, naturalistic appearance with gentle contrast.

artworks.title: Goats Resting above a River Gorge (Narni, Italy)
artworks.medium: gray wash on card
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of a vast landscape with a high horizon and open sky stretching into the distance. On the horizon, there are faint outlines of distant hills or mountains. To the right, there is a building complex on a cliff overlooking a river below. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, emphasizing natural land contours. The color palette is muted grays and off-whites, creating an atmospheric depth. In the foreground, there is rocky terrain with indistinct shapes that may represent animals.

artworks.title: Mahatta
artworks.medium: gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from above of an open area with tall trees, obscuring the horizon. In the distance, there is a building with dome-shaped roofs and a small group of people nearby. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, emphasizing texture over detail. The color palette is monochromatic in various shades of gray.

artworks.title: Thebes
artworks.medium: black and gray wash over traces of graphite on card
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch featuring an ancient Egyptian scene. The point of view is slightly elevated, capturing palm trees and ruins in an expansive setting. Stone structures and temple remnants are visible against the sky, with palm trees and distant mountains in the background. The sketch uses loose brushstrokes in shades of gray and black, creating a soft, atmospheric quality. Water buffalo are depicted near a body of water, adding life to the scene. The palette is limited to grayscale tones, providing depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Avisavella, Ceylon
artworks.medium: gray wash on wove paper, laid down on card
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a river with tall palm trees on each side. In the background, there are faint mountain ranges. The brushstrokes are loose, creating movement in the foliage and reflection on the water. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey. Two figures are seen interacting by the water.

artworks.title: View across a Bay (Monaco)
artworks.medium: gray wash and black wash on card
artworks.description: The image features a landscape seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned about a third of the way down from the top, with a cliffside extending into the distance. There are structural elements resembling buildings or ruins. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, capturing the scenery with fluid strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to create contrasts and depth. Closest to us are trees framed by dark, broad brushstrokes on the right, with more nebulous forms on the left. The landscape transitions into rocky terrain and the cliff, creating depth towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Bridge with Mountains in the Distance (Ventimiglia)
artworks.medium: gray wash over traces of graphite on card
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a bridge stretching across, positioned above the midpoint. The horizon is obscured by merging structures and mountain ranges. On the left, there is a sizable building with a pointed spire. Watercolors create a soft, textured finish with loosely applied brushstrokes, giving an impressionistic feel. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, comprising various shades of gray, creating a tranquil atmosphere. In the distance, hills or mountains rise gradually, adding depth. The calm water below the bridge reflects the structures above.

artworks.title: Napoli
artworks.medium: gray and black wash over traces of graphite on card
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear view of the land extending towards the mountains. The horizon is positioned about one-third from the top, separating the land from the sky, with mountains and a peak emitting smoke visible. In the foreground, there is dense foliage depicted with loose brushstrokes, creating texture and depth. The style appears to be using soft washes and subtle lines, possibly in watercolor or ink. The color palette is predominantly gray, creating a muted and serene atmosphere. The sky in the distance shows minimal clouds.

artworks.title: Dr. J. A. Marshall, Physician & Surgeon, Williamsburg, Indiana
artworks.medium: tintype
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one foot rested on an urn-like pedestal. He is facing forward, with his right hand on the pedestal and his left hand holding a hat. The man has a serious expression, a mustache, and short, wavy hair peeking out from under another hat. He is wearing a light-colored suit jacket, waistcoat, and dark trousers, with a pocket watch chain around his neck. The background depicts a painted scene with a large house and trees. The floor is wooden with a subtle pattern.

artworks.title: A Bishop Blessing a King
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a group of people surrounding a central figure. The central figure and others are depicted in dynamic poses, suggesting movement or gesture. The central figure appears to hold a significant position within the scene. The figures are dressed in flowing robes or tunics, with some standing and others kneeling. There are no distinct facial features due to the sketch's level of detail. The setting features large columns and an archway, suggesting an architectural space. The sketch conveys a sense of a gathered assembly or a dramatic scene without providing explicit narrative details.

artworks.title: Dwarf Musicians of Granada
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with light brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. On the left, a person crouches playing a stringed instrument. The individual has a beard, aged facial features, wears a headscarf, long-sleeved shirt, a vest, and pants. On the right, another person stands holding a tambourine. This individual also has aged facial features, wears a hat, a scarf, a loose long-sleeved garment, and pants. Both figures are on a textured ground. In front of the crouching person, there is a bowl. The background is a sketched wall.

artworks.title: At Tenby
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with gray and brown wash and touches of red chalk over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a shoreline with a small ship near a stone building by the water. There are subtle brushstrokes in the background leading to a faint structure on a hill. The painting style features delicate brushwork and a soft color palette of browns, beiges, and grays. A figure stands near a small boat and fishing nets on the shore, with the ship in calm waters near a stone wall. The scene appears peaceful and nostalgic, with a balance between land and sea.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Ellen Seymour"
artworks.medium: brown wash and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the cover page for "Ellen Seymour; or, The Bud and the Flower" by Mrs. Savile Shepherd. The drawing depicts a scene with a house or chapel in the background surrounded by trees, with figures in the foreground. The drawing is done in sepia tones. The upper section features the book's title and author's name in a decorative script, framed with a border.

artworks.title: An Evening Landscape with a Distant Cathedral
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing with a ground-level point of view. The scene depicts a cluster of tall, slender trees dominating the view, with buildings and a distant structure visible in the background. The drawing is executed in shades of grey with soft and fluid brushstrokes, creating a sense of lightness and airiness. The monochromatic palette conveys a serene and calming visual effect, with subtle contrasts between light and shadow defining the elements in the image.

artworks.title: Dancing Woman with a Tambourine
artworks.medium: pen and red ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person in motion. The person appears to be dancing or moving energetically, with one foot slightly lifted off the ground. Their body is angled forward with arms raised high above their head. One hand is holding a circular object, possibly a tambourine. The facial expression shows distinct features with slightly parted lips and prominently outlined eyes. They have curly hair that frames their face and appears to have a gentle wave. The clothing drawn on the person suggests a flowing garment, with the upper portion closer to the body and draped fabric swirling around the legs, adding a sense of motion. The person is not visibly wearing any jewelry. The background is plain, with no recognizable features, emphasizing the figure's dynamic pose.

artworks.title: Two Chinese Pigs
artworks.medium: gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two pigs. The drawing shows two pigs standing side by side, viewed in profile, against a simple, shaded background. The pig on the right is labeled "Fig 1" and stands with a strong, solid posture. Its body is round and bulky. The pig on the left, labeled "Fig 2," is slightly turned with a relaxed stance. Both pigs are meticulously rendered with fine lines and shading to capture their volume and texture. The background is minimal, with subtle indications of grass beneath their feet.

artworks.title: View of an Italian Town (after Titian or Domenico Campagnola)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of buildings gradually rising to the left. The horizon is filled with more buildings, towers, and spires. The brushstrokes create texture and detail in the rooftops, walls, and surrounding areas. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving an antique effect. Diagonal lines closest to us suggest pathways or roads. Trees and vegetation in the distance frame the architecture.

artworks.title: Cavalry Skirmish
artworks.medium: pen and black, brown, and red ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cavalry battle scene with two mounted figures engaged in a sword duel. One rider wears a blue coat and feathered hat, while the other wears a green attire. The horses display dynamic movement, with one rearing up and the other charging. The background depicts a cloudy sky and sketched elements suggesting a chaotic battlefield. The artist uses watercolors and bold outlines to highlight the action and expressions. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Landscape with Cattle, a Goat, and a Resting Shepherd
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on the ground with a stick nearby. Two cows and a sheep are next to a large rock formation, and in the distance, there is a building with a domed roof. The landscape has gentle hills, and the style features detailed etching with precise lines for texture and shading. The color palette is sepia, giving the image an antique look.

artworks.title: A Cloister
artworks.medium: brown wash over graphite, with touches of scratching out (in the figure by the door) on wove paper
artworks.description: The interior of a grand architectural space is depicted in the image. The perspective leads the eye deeper into the scene through a series of arches. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is on the structural elements of the building. High vaulted ceilings and columns recede into the distance, framing a group of figures. The brushstrokes are fine and controlled, contributing to a detailed rendering of the architecture. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, creating a warm and aged appearance that emphasizes shadows and light interplay. Light cascades from openings on the left, illuminating the columns and casting shadows on the stone floor.

artworks.title: The Forest at Courdemanche
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a natural landscape. The scene includes a cluster of tall trees on the left side, extending vertically towards the sky. The horizon is marked by the end of the tree line. The style features soft and slightly abstracted pencil strokes, creating a textured appearance capturing dappled light on the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey for depth. Closest to us is an area of horizontal lines indicating a field or open space, leading up to the trees. The background shows denser shading, possibly indicating thicker vegetation.

artworks.title: A Landscape with a River
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated vantage point. A tall tree is depicted on the left side with soft brushstrokes for its branches and foliage. Adjacent to the tree, a building's steeple is visible. In the middle of the composition, a bridge spans the scene, connecting the land on the left to a distance bank of trees. The strokes give a sketch-like quality to the scene, capturing it with fluidity and softness. The color palette is predominantly charcoal gray, black, and natural paper tone. Two figures walk on a path close to the viewer, with a river and vague structures in the background. Distant structures or homes are faintly outlined, creating depth in the landscape.
